lines.text: Super Saiyan! Super Saiyan! Super Saiyan! Super Saiyan!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: First off, we got good old Super Saiyan.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Everyone knows this one.

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: Wait, you seriously just put Super at the beginning of it?

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: That's kind of lazy if you ask me.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And this? Is a Super Duper Saiyan.

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: You don't look... I mean, is there a difference?

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: I literally cannot tell.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And this... is to go even further beyond!

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: Oh no, go ahead, Goku, waste the last time you have there whipping out your dick!

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: Ow, do you hear that?

lines.speaker: Majin Buu
lines.text: I feel that.

lines.speaker: Majin Buu
lines.text: I taste that.

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: What's that smell?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: This is a Super Duper Duper Saiyan.

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: I'm just going to call those Super Saiyan 1, 2, and 3.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Okay, that's boring.

lines.speaker: Majin Buu
lines.text: Oh, very boring.

lines.speaker: Majin Buu
lines.text: We fight now?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Majin Buu
lines.text: Ooh, ah, ooh, ah, ooh, ah, ooh, ah, ooh, woohoo!
